title: Surface-Evaporation Call-Local Allocation and Scaling Qualification

scope_boundary.statement: F-PE11 addresses only call-local profile allocation/copy churn in the already-qualified restricted surface-evaporation runtime path. Existing scientific equations, constants, provider physics, supported-configuration scope, public runtime seams and accepted observable semantics remain reference authority.

confirmed_owning_steps: kernel_committed_state_t%snapshot deep-clones the private physical transaction state
fmr_build_committed_process_hydraulic_view copies the cloned profile into a temporary soil-water state
build_process_hydraulic_view copies both profile arrays into the owning hydraulic view
detached_state_from_view copies both profile arrays again before capacity evaluation
baseline_characterization.transactional_lower_bound: The committed snapshot clone remains required; F-PE11 removes only copies downstream of that detached clone.

candidate.strategy: ownership transfer behind unchanged public seams
candidate.description: Keep fmr_build_committed_process_hydraulic_view as the existing public committed-state read seam. Inside that routine, transfer allocatable arrays from the already-detached committed snapshot into the owning hydraulic view using move_alloc. Keep fmr_materialize_restricted_surface_evaporation unchanged as a public routine and transfer those view-owned arrays into its private capacity base state in detached_state_from_view using move_alloc.
candidate.expected_profile_copy_reduction: from committed clone plus three downstream full-profile copies to committed clone only in the surface-evaporation materialization path

rejected_candidate.strategy: new public fmr_detach_committed_soil_water_state seam plus direct materializer bypass
rejected_candidate.reason: Broader than necessary and changes the public runtime module surface. It is not required to remove the allocation churn.

forbidden_changes: new public runtime or solver API for this optimization
B110 surface-capacity equations or conductivity-mean policy
direct pointer or alias into private committed physical state
checkpoint, trial, commit or rollback semantics

qualification_gates.source_scope: only the two pinned runtime source files may differ from F-CI41P
qualification_gates.public_surface_identity: no new public procedure/type and existing public routine signatures remain unchanged
qualification_gates.allocation_structure: no downstream profile allocate/copy remains in fmr_build_committed_process_hydraulic_view or detached_state_from_view; ownership transfer is from detached local owners only
scientific_identity: paired candidate-versus-F-CI41P exact observable identity using frozen F-VQ56 abstract and real-B110 runtime oracles
performance: paired same-runner baseline-versus-candidate timing with balanced process order and identical workload
no portable or universal speedup claim
retain as a performance optimization only if timing supports an attributable benefit; otherwise restore the F-CI41P production source while retaining evidence
qualification_gates.scaling: MultiSWAP scaling must be characterized before any scaling claim
